command: git fetch origin --prune; $branch = git branch --show-current; if ($branch -ne 'main') { throw "Expected main branch, found $branch" }; $dirty = @(git status --porcelain); if ($dirty.Count -ne 0) { $dirty | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; throw 'Refusing to fast-forward a dirty development checkout.' }; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Fast-forward failed.' }; Write-Output 'SYNCED_HEAD'; git rev-parse HEAD; Write-Output 'SYNCED_STATUS'; git status --short
